Santa Marta City Tour (3 hours)

Immerse yourself in the magic of Santa Marta, the oldest city in Colombia. On this captivating 3-hour guided tour, you'll wander through vibrant colonial streets steeped in history. Discover the secrets of Simón Bolívar Park, admire the majestic Cathedral Basilica, and feel the warm Caribbean breeze along the scenic Paseo de Bastidas waterfront. Our expert local guide will bring fascinating legends to life as you explore the bustling craft market and legendary Fishermen's Quarter. The perfect introduction to the culture, flavor, and joy of the Colombian Caribbean!

Cabo San Juan Day Trek + Fast-Track Entry

Embark on the ultimate jungle adventure through Tayrona National Park to the iconic Cabo San Juan beach. River Tubing on Guachaca River

Combine gentle thrills with total tranquility on this River Tubing adventure down the lush Guachaca River. We’ll start with a scenic 1-hour ecological hike up unexplored trails, where birdsong and dense tropical vegetation deeply connect you with nature. Upon reaching the elevated starting point, jump into your tube and let the gentle river currents carry you downstream. Float peacefully through breathtaking jungle landscapes and relax to the rhythm of the water on this truly refreshing experience.

Cultural Trek

Bunkuany Ruins & Kogui Indigenous Experience

Dare to discover the Sierra Nevada's best-kept secret: the Bunkuany Ruins, affectionately known as the 'Mini Lost City'. On this private 7 km archaeological trek, you'll hike ancient stone terraces built centuries ago by the Tayrona ancestors. Led by certified expert guides, you'll immerse yourself in the lush tropical jungle, spot exotic wildlife, and visit the sacred Kogui village of Tayku. Top off this unforgettable journey by swimming in the pure, pristine waters of a secluded mountain river. A true cultural gem!

🐒 Wildlife Focus 🏛️ Cultural History 👨‍👩‍👧 Private Group

Kogui Indigenous Communities - Tayku

Disconnect from the modern world and embark on a profound spiritual journey into the heart of Tayrona culture. After an invigorating 80-minute uphill hike through dense emerald jungle, you’ll arrive at Tayku, a sacred ancestral territory inhabited by the Kogui indigenous people. Experience their stunning traditional thatched-roof dwellings firsthand, learn about their unique worldview and deep respect for 'Mother Earth', and witness a peaceful lifestyle that has remained in perfect harmony with the Sierra Nevada for centuries.

Kogui Horseback Tour, Indigenous Village & Orinoco Waterfall

Feel the freedom of horseback riding through the breathtaking landscapes of the Sierra Nevada. This ultimate adventure begins at Los Cocos, ascending a lush forested path to an authentic indigenous village where locals share the ancient secrets of cacao farming. Your horseback trail then leads you to the majestic Orinoco Waterfall—a hidden oasis deep in the jungle. Dismount, dive into its refreshing crystal-clear waters, and relax entirely before your scenic descent. A perfect blend of nature, culture, and adventure!

Enchanted Sacred Pool Tour (Poza Encantada)

Discover a secret oasis hidden deep within the heart of the tropical forest. After a gentle, scenic 35-minute ecological hike surrounded by the soothing sounds of nature and endemic birdsong, you will arrive at the Poza Encantada (Enchanted Pool). This natural sanctuary will take your breath away with its small crystal-clear cascading waterfalls and smooth stone jacuzzis carved by mountain streams. A pristine, sacred, and truly magical spot, perfect for recharging your energy, swimming in pure waters, and reconnecting with absolute tranquility.

Los Naranjos Beach Horseback Tour (Tayrona Area)

Live out a cinematic dream with our exclusive horseback ride along the breathtaking Los Naranjos Beach. Starting at the San Martín entrance, you'll cross the refreshing waters of the Piedra River on horseback and ride through beautiful shaded trails on the edge of Tayrona National Park. The climax of the journey is emerging onto the expansive golden sands of Los Naranjos, where you'll ride right along the Caribbean shoreline, listening to the crashing waves and feeling the ocean breeze. A spectacularly romantic 2-hour experience.

Bird Watching Tour in Tayrona National Park

For true nature lovers and photography enthusiasts, this early morning birdwatching expedition is an unmissable rendezvous. Starting at 5:30 am, just as the Tayrona jungle awakens with a symphony of birdsong, an expert guide will lead you to prime spots to spot fascinating endemic and migratory species. Armed with specialized optical gear provided for the tour, you'll marvel at vibrant toucans, iridescent hummingbirds, and colorful parrots in their pristine natural habitat, all while enjoying the serene peace of sunrise in one of the world's most biodiverse hotspots.
